article.title: Wawrinka retires in front of home crowd after defeat to Lehecka
article.summary: Three-time Grand Slam champion Stan Wawrinka retires in front of his home crowd after losing in straight sets to Jiri Lehecka in the opening round of the Swiss Indoors in Basel.
